hook: Agar Earth Ghoomna Band Kar De Toh?

points.title: Toofani hawayein
points.text: Hawa 1,600 km/h ki speed se chalti rahegi. Kisi bhi cyclone se zyada taqatwar!

points.title: Samundar poles ki taraf
points.text: Paani North aur South Pole ki taraf chala jayega. Beech mein naya zameen ka patta.

points.title: Ek din = ek saal
points.text: 6 mahine lagaatar din, phir 6 mahine lambi raat.

takeaway: Earth ka ghoomna hi humein zinda rakhta hai.
cta: Follow karo, roz ek naya sawaal
